name: Gladias
about: Gladias is a Veridian acolyte, then Keeper, in the anonymous Order of Steering, and one of the book's three leads. The book gives his age and almost nothing about his looks, so the appearance below is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: I was born thirty-nine years ago.

facts.fact: Father of Zven and Lily, husband of Seila.

facts.quote: he would get in and become a Sentinel - or, if he changed his mind, a Keeper
facts.fact: An Acolyte in the Order of Steering at the start, aiming to become a Sentinel or Keeper.

facts.quote: the same signature Veridian Privacy Robe that he was wearing
facts.fact: Wears the Veridian Privacy Robe in public.

facts.quote: He pulled on a strap on his privacy robe's front face cover
facts.fact: Adjusts the face-cover strap of his robe in crowds.

facts.quote: his shoes, which had high heels to raise his height to the same level as other robe wearers
facts.fact: Robe shoes hide his real height, so his height is unknown.

facts.quote: wearing a privacy robe without putting on the face cover or hood
facts.fact: Sometimes wears the robe open-faced with the hood down near home.

facts.quote: Gladias took off his privacy robe, though keeping his neck band on
facts.fact: Wears a neck band; takes the robe off at home.

facts.quote: I'm going to go on some long walks in the forest
facts.fact: Likes long walks in the forest.

facts.quote: he had learned programming by writing an alternative client
as a de-facto Kungaupei advisor, Gladias certainly qualified
facts.fact: Later lives in Dzego as an adviser to the Kungaupei.

descriptor: a man of about forty, medium height and slim, light olive skin, short wavy chestnut-brown hair, a neatly trimmed short brown beard and thoughtful hazel eyes, wearing a moss-green linen overshirt over a cream crewneck, charcoal trousers, brown leather walking shoes, a slim grey neck band and a plain wristwatch
